# archestra_knowledge_base (Data Source)

Looks up an existing knowledge base by ID — useful for referencing KBs created out-of-band (e.g., through the UI) from Terraform-managed agents.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a knowledge base by ID — useful when the KB was created
# out-of-band (e.g., through the platform UI) and you want to wire
# it into a Terraform-managed agent.

data "archestra_knowledge_base" "imported" {
  id = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
}

resource "archestra_agent" "support" {
  name               = "support"
  llm_model          = "llama3"
  llm_api_key_id     = archestra_llm_provider_api_key.ollama.id
  knowledge_base_ids = [data.archestra_knowledge_base.imported.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Knowledge base UUID.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Free-form description, if set.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status managed by the backend.
- `updated_at` (String) Last-update timestamp (RFC 3339).
